p1: [low, ominous] A dead man on a beach had a secret pocket. [whispers] Inside, a note that means: it is ended.
[low] Adelaide, nineteen forty-eight. Found at dawn, lying against the sea wall.
[low, tense] The night before, a couple saw him lift his arm... [whispers] and let it drop.
[low, cold] No wallet. No I-D. Labels cut out of his clothes.
[low] The pathologist was sure it wasn't natural. [low, ominous] No poison was ever found.
[low] The note was torn from the last page of a Persian poetry book.
[low, tense] A man later handed police that exact book. Found in a parked car near the beach.
[low] The torn page matched. [whispers] In the back... five lines of letters. [low, ominous] A code.
[low, slow] Nobody has ever cracked it.
[low] In twenty twenty-two, D-N-A from his hair gave researchers a name: Carl Webb.
[low, tense] Police still haven't confirmed it. [whispers] And the code? Still unsolved.
